entry_gate: Fresh main source checked; source baseline captured
primary_goal: Complete baseline and close live/site/brand/hosting/sales gates
required_outputs: Audit report; feature preservation matrix; storage inventory; policy decision log; staged new-photo manifest; handoff
exit_gate: Need live Android/Pages validation + documented platform/brand/rights/sales decisions
notes: Source inspection completed; browser/live/Android are NOT TESTED. No code changes.

entry_gate: Phase 1 exit accepted; policy/hosting gates recorded
primary_goal: Connected information architecture and common content data model
required_outputs: Route map; data schema; cross-link validator; responsive acceptance matrix
exit_gate: No broken/orphan links; old IDs/data retained
notes: Do not begin until Phase 1 gates are documented.

entry_gate: Phase 2 contracts stable; suitable content platform approved
primary_goal: Interconnected Hinglish story universe with choices and tone controls
required_outputs: New story data only; integration patches; story tests; editorial checklist
exit_gate: Existing stories/branches preserved; choices, skip/stop and saving verified
notes: Gaali/tone and content intensity are separate settings.

entry_gate: Story/link schema stable; exact current wheel locations documented
primary_goal: Fix and connect original three wheels plus Dirty/Wild and couples prompts
required_outputs: Wheel result definitions; small integration patches; geometry/result tests
exit_gate: All pointer/result matches, reset/re-roll/skip work; no original wheel lost

entry_gate: Products classified accurately; allowed commerce/affiliate path documented
primary_goal: Honest product discovery and viable sales plan
required_outputs: New product schema/status files; provider policy evidence; commerce plan
exit_gate: No fake prices/specs/stock; checkout off without written approval
notes: Existing concept prices must stay non-transactional.

entry_gate: Brand, photo rights and product-claim status reviewed
primary_goal: Wellness, Fit Studio, collections and newly submitted media in correct places
required_outputs: New assets only; manifest; rights/claim review; patch instructions; image tests
exit_gate: Every public image has placement/status/rights path; all existing image records preserved
notes: Current batch: 10 staged WebP variants; not wired into live source.

entry_gate: All modules integrated on a review target; hosting decision satisfied
primary_goal: Complete integration, regression, accessibility, performance, privacy and release
required_outputs: Test report, Android matrix, rollback note and final handoff
exit_gate: Unresolved critical risks disclosed; no unsupported production-ready claims
notes: Release status must distinguish static test, runtime, live site, and physical-device results.
